description: Starter manifest for conversational assistants that want durable user memory across sessions. Send interaction_type=analysis with the conversation text as content (runs the manifest-driven extraction pipeline), or interaction_type=chat_log with a messages[] array (universal conversation extractor). Recall the memory back per turn via POST /v1/recall.
design_principles: Memory is about the user, not the conversation: prefer durable facts over chit-chat.
Extract only self-disclosed information; never store assistant-inferred conclusions as user facts.
Every commitment carries its spoken deadline so recall can surface overdue items.

patch_types.description: A durable fact the user disclosed about themselves (role, family, circumstances).
Likes, dislikes, and how the user wants the assistant to behave.
patch_types.cue_guidance: Name the subject of the preference (a food, a workflow, a communication style), not the conversation.

patch_types.description: An explicit aim the user is working toward.
Something the user said they will do, with any deadline as spoken.
A named person in the user's life. value.text is the NAME ONLY.

connection_labels.label: involves
connection_labels.description: The named person is part of this commitment or goal.

entity_types.description: Named people in the user's life, indexed for recall matching.
Named recurring subjects (a hobby, a project, a place).

extraction_prompt_guidance.role_context: You are a structured data extraction engine building long-term memory for a conversational assistant. Extract durable, user-disclosed facts — never transient conversation mechanics, never assistant inferences presented as user facts.
